default_exit._why: one exit for every family so rules compete on the same footing; the owner will decide the demo stop/take-profit later and this block changes then (a change = a new screen run, its variants counted again)
default_exit._fills: signal at the close of bar t; market order at the open of the 1-minute bar that starts at t's close (+ slippage); every 1-minute bar from the entry minute on: stop first (fills at the stop or the gap open, - slippage), then the target (a limit: needs a trade 1 tick through, fills at the target); time exit at the open of the first minute at or after entry + max_hold_min; flat at the session's flatten time; one position at a time; at most max_entries_per_session entries per session

E-838.title: Round-number touch rejection
E-838.hypothesis: Resting orders cluster at round index/dollar levels; a bar that touches the nearest round level and closes back on the side it opened from means the level held, so trade away from it.

E-839.title: Day-open reclaim follow
E-839.hypothesis: After trading on one side of the session open for a while, a close back across it shifts the intraday average holder into profit/loss and the move follows.

E-840.title: Efficiency-ratio ignition follow
E-840.hypothesis: When Kaufman's efficiency ratio jumps above a threshold the tape moves in one direction with little noise; slower participants chase and the move continues.

E-842.title: Heikin-Ashi colour flip after a run
E-842.hypothesis: A flip of smoothed candle colour after a run of the opposite colour marks a change of short-term control.

E-843.title: Stochastic extreme exit follow
E-843.hypothesis: When the close leaves the bottom (top) zone of the recent range, sellers (buyers) are exhausted; trade the bounce away from the extreme.

E-844.title: VWAP slope flip with side agreement
E-844.hypothesis: When the session VWAP changes slope and price sits on the same side, the average trade price is trending that way and money-flow follows.

E-845.title: Rolling z-score stretch fade
E-845.hypothesis: Price stretched more than a few standard deviations from its recent mean is typically a liquidity-driven overshoot by impatient flow; fade it back.

E-846.title: EMA cross with VWAP agreement
E-846.hypothesis: A fast/slow EMA cross while price is on the matching side of VWAP combines momentum and position vs average cost; follow the cross.

E-847.title: Heavy-volume climax reversal bar
E-847.hypothesis: A very heavy bar that engulfs the previous bar against a prior move is capitulation of the trapped side; follow the reversal bar.
